dedupe_keys.name: adversarial attacks on leakage detectors in water distribution networks

description: The authors evaluate vulnerability of water-network leakage detectors using three algorithmic approaches on two benchmark networks. The documented object supports model sensitivity and fault-detector assessment. It does not establish a publicly deployed control system or reproduce an actual intrusion. The inspected descriptive metadata are sufficient to identify the studied model role, while executable code, detector parameters and input observations remain unknown. No operational attack procedure or measurement values were collected. Reported results are bounded to the benchmark detectors and perturbation assumptions described by the authors. The source authors provide the native description and declared publication or package metadata through Zenodo. Geographic coverage and temporal coverage are limited to explicitly named observations or benchmark applications; remaining coverage is unknown. Metadata and file descriptors were reviewed, with no dataset values, source code, model archives or paper bodies intentionally fetched. Public access to descriptive papers does not establish executable availability or rights to all linked components. Licence and cost for executable components remain as explicitly stated above or unknown. This supports infrastructure simulation and the specific source-defined modelling role.
